name: adaptive-task-routing
description: Route complex work to an appropriate conversation context, model, and reasoning effort using shared runtime capability detection and independent user controls.

interface.shortDescription: Choose context, model, and reasoning for complex work.
interface.longDescription: The primary adaptive-task-routing skill coordinates independent context and model routers after substantial analyses identify actionable next work and before executing substantial phases. It covers multi-step audits, scans, research, planning, coding, debugging, architecture and validation. Directly selected child routers dispatch general tasks back to the coordinator while explicit context-only and model-only requests remain scoped. Concrete recommendations stay visible, and per-operation capability checks allow verified automation or clear user actions.
defaultPrompt: Use adaptive task routing before the next substantial phase.
